title: Mankey 45/91 - Reverse Holo - Pokemon Paldean Fates - Common - NM English
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
This Mankey card from the Pokémon TCG features a Fighting attribute and is part of the Paldean Fates set. It has a card number of 045 and is a Common rarity with a Reverse Holo finish. The card is in English and was manufactured by Nintendo in 2024. 

The card's age level is 6+ and it is a great addition to any collector's collection. The card features the character Mankey and has a Reverse Holo finish, making it a unique and sought-after card. Don't miss out on the opportunity to add this card to your collection!
